home.title: InoRobot | INOVANCE Robot Tools
home.description: InoRobot provides model selection, 3D simulation, project generation, software, manuals, and debugging tools for INOVANCE robots.

legacy.INOVANCE 서보의 PC 기반 Ethernet 모션 제어 구성과 주요: Explore PC-based Ethernet motion control with INOVANCE servos, including system configurations and key specifications.
legacy.이노로봇(InoRobot Assistant)은 이노밴스 로봇(INOVAN: InoRobot supports model selection, 3D simulation, project generation, software, manuals, and debugging for INOVANCE robots.
legacy.InoRobot Assistant는 INOVANCE Robot을 설계부터: InoRobot Assistant supports every stage of working with INOVANCE robots, from design and programming to commissioning.
Choose the tool you need to get started.
legacy.INOVANCE 로봇의 라인업을 확인하세요. 선택한 모델과 옵션 구성을: Explore the INOVANCE robot lineup. Save the selected model and options as a PDF for ordering, and download 2D and 3D CAD files.
legacy.INOVANCE 로봇의 관절 및 Base JOG, Tool·설비 배치와: Simulate INOVANCE robots with joint and Base JOG, Tool and equipment placement, and imported 3D models.
legacy.로봇 Tool 부하 조건에 따른 모델 적합성을 판정합니다. 관련 모멘트: Evaluate robot suitability for your tool load. Calculate moments and allowable loads to select the best model.
legacy.로봇 모델과 공정 구성을 선택하면, 컨트롤러에 바로 적용 가능한 프로젝트: Select a robot model and process configuration to automatically generate a controller-ready project structure.
Download the latest software for robot control and configuration.
legacy.로봇 매뉴얼, 교육자료, 인증서, 통신 프로파일 다운로드 및 조회: Browse and download robot manuals, training materials, certificates, and communication profiles.
Use helpful tools for robot debugging and troubleshooting.

legacy.모델 카드를 선택해 상세 구성 화면을 열고 케이블, 티치펜던트와 통신 옵: Select a model card to open its configuration, then choose the cable, teach pendant, and communication options.

legacy.CAD를 내려받고 구성을 담은 다음, 구성 목록에서 엑셀을 내려받아 모델: Download the CAD, add the configuration to the list, then export Excel from that list to review the model and options.

legacy.실제 3D Simulation 화면에서 로봇 생성, JOG, Test 모: See robot creation, JOG, Test model placement, snap movement, and repeat operation in the actual 3D Simulation screen.
legacy.모델 선택 메뉴에서 IR-S4 로봇을 선택하고 실제 3D 모델이 생성되는: Choose the IR-S4 robot and watch its actual 3D model be created.
Changing a joint JOG value moves both the real robot pose and coordinates.
legacy.Test 버튼과 확인 버튼을 눌러 설비 CAD와 진공 Tool을 실제 장: Use Test and Confirm to place the equipment CAD and vacuum Tool in the actual scene.
legacy.스냅 이동을 켜고 CAD 면의 스냅점을 선택해 로봇을 해당 위치로 이동합: Enable Snap Move and choose a CAD-face snap point to move the robot there.
legacy.JOG Panel을 열고 스냅 이동 버튼을 누른 뒤 CAD 면의 스냅점을: Open the JOG Panel, press Snap Move, then select a snap point on the CAD face to move the robot there.
legacy.프로그램 화면에서 P[0]과 P[1]을 티칭한 뒤 Repeat와 Run으: Teach P[0] and P[1] in Program, then use Repeat and Run for automatic cyclic motion.
legacy.P[0]과 P[1]을 티칭하고 Repeat와 Run을 누른 뒤 패널을 닫: Teach P[0] and P[1], press Repeat and Run, then close the panels to watch the robot cycle automatically.
Load the robot to simulate from the model menu.
Move the robot pose with JOINT or BASE JOG.
Adjust position, rotation, and placement in TCP settings and the model tree.
Extend the scene with 3D import and CAD tools.
legacy.실제 Tool Selector 화면에서 모델 선택, 부하 입력과 적합성: Follow model selection, load entry, and suitability calculation in the actual Tool Selector.
Set the model and J5-to-flange distance.
Enter mass, center-of-gravity distances, and inertia.
Import CAD and set the Tool origin and TCP.
Select Calculate to review suitability and margin.
legacy.실제 Project Generator 화면에서 로봇, 공정, 옵션을 선택: Select the robot, process, and options, then generate a project in the actual Project Generator.
First, enter a project name and choose the robot model to use.
Add and arrange required work steps in Processes.
Choose generated program features from Options.
Select Generate to create the controller-ready project structure.
legacy.Robot Tool Selector 사용 방법 보기: View the Robot Tool Selector guide
legacy.실제 Document 화면에서 검색·필터로 필요한 매뉴얼을 찾고 내려받는: Find and download manuals with search and filters in the actual Document screen.
Choose model, controller, and document-type filters.
legacy.Software, Training, Communication 카테고리를: Combine Software, Training, and Communication categories.
Narrow the list with keywords such as SCARA, installation, or communication.
Use the view or download button on the document card you need.
Compare matching model specifications and select the robot you want.
Configure cable type and length, teach pendant, and communication expansion options.
legacy.구성 내역 PDF와 2D·3D CAD 파일을 내려받아 설계와 발주에 활용: Download the configuration PDF and 2D/3D CAD files for design and ordering.
Your selected model and options are included in the files.
legacy.Robot Tool Selector 버전 기록 보기: Open Robot Tool Selector version history

Press 6-Axis or SCARA to keep only models of that type.
Pick a payload larger than the combined weight of the tool and workpiece.
Pick the arm length (reach) that covers your work area.
Only models that meet every selected condition are shown as cards.
Press a card to open its specifications and configuration options.
Choose the flexible type if the cable bends as the robot moves.
If needed, add a teach pendant and choose whether it has an emergency-stop cover.
Add a communication card to connect to a PLC or other device over PROFINET.
legacy.선택한 구성에 맞춰 구매 코드가 자동으로 바뀝니다. 주문할 때 이 코드를: The purchase code updates to match your configuration. Use this code when ordering.
Download the robot's 2D and 3D CAD files for equipment design.
Add the selected model and options to the configuration list.
legacy.구성 목록에서 엑셀 다운로드: Export Excel from the configuration list
Download the listed items and their codes as an Excel file.
Check that the Excel file lists the product details and the options you chose.
Choose a robot from the list at the top and it appears in the 3D view.
Use the mouse to rotate and zoom the view and look at the robot from any angle.
Press JOG to open the panel that moves the robot axes.
Drag a slider to rotate that joint; the tool-tip coordinates change with it.
Press Test to open a window for choosing practice equipment and tools.
legacy.모델과 수량을 정한 뒤 일괄 가져오기를 누르면 설비와 Tool이 배치됩니: Set the quantity for each model, then import them to place the equipment and tool in the scene.
legacy.불러온 설비와 Tool이 목록에 표시되며, 선택해 위치를 바꿀 수 있습니: The loaded equipment and tool appear in the list, where you can select them and change their position.
Sends the robot tool tip to an exact point on the CAD model, such as a corner or center.
legacy.이동할 위치가 있는 CAD 면을 클릭하면 선택할 수 있는 점이 표시됩니다: Click the CAD face that holds the target to show the points you can pick.
Click the point you want to use as the target.
The robot tool tip (TCP) moves to the selected point.
This panel saves the current pose as a position (P) and runs positions in order.
Move the robot to the pose you want, then press + to save it as P[0].
Move to another pose and press it again to save P[1].
With repeat on, the robot keeps moving between the saved positions.
Press Run to move through P[0] and P[1] in order.
Close the panels to watch the repeated motion in a larger view.
Choose the robot you will use from the list. This example uses R25.
legacy.모델을 고르면 J5–플랜지 거리와 허용 질량·토크·관성값이 자동으로 채워: Choosing a model fills in the J5-to-flange distance and the allowed mass, torque and inertia.
legacy.값을 알고 있으면 모드 A, 재질·치수나 STEP CAD로 계산하려면 모: Use mode A if you know the values, or modes B–D to calculate them from material, dimensions or a STEP CAD file.
Enter the combined weight of the tool and the object it holds, in kg.
legacy.끝단 플랜지에서 부하 무게중심까지의 거리를 축별로 mm 단위로 입력합니다: Enter the distance from the end flange to the load's center of gravity on each axis, in mm.
legacy.부하 무게중심 기준 관성값입니다. 모르면 모드 B~D로 계산할 수 있습니: These are inertia values about the load's center of gravity. If you do not know them, calculate them with modes B–D.
Press Calculate to compare the load with the robot's limits.
legacy.항목별 여유율 확인: Check the margin for each item
An item is OK when the calculated value is within the limit. A higher margin means more headroom.
legacy.모든 항목이 OK면 적합으로 표시되어 해당 Tool을 설치할 수 있습니다: If every item is OK, the tool is marked suitable and can be installed.
This name is used for the generated project and its ZIP file.
Choose the robot you will use; the program is generated for that model.
legacy.각 줄에서 유형·동작·Tool·비전 보정을 고르며, 위에서부터 순서대로: In each row choose the type, action, tool and vision correction. Rows run from top to bottom.
Press + to add the next task row.
Stage is for loading or unloading parts on a stage with vacuum pads on its floor.
legacy.Get은 집기, Put은 놓기입니다. 예시는 Tray에서 집어 Stage: Get picks a part and Put places it. This example picks from a tray and places it on a stage.
Each change immediately updates the robot program that will be generated.
Use the Options button to add features such as monitoring or teaching mode.
For example, turning on TCP speed monitoring adds speed-monitoring code.
Press Apply to add the options to the code preview.
Generating the project saves the controller project as a ZIP file.
In the list on the left, expand a category such as hardware or software manuals.
Choose a product group to keep only its documents. The number on the right is the document count.
The document count and list update right away.
Type a model name or a word such as installation or communication to narrow the list.
Each row shows the document name, language, product group and date.
Press Preview to open the PDF in a new tab.
Look at the cover and contents to confirm it is the document you need.
Close the tab to return to the document list.
Press Download to save the PDF file right away.
Import the Tool's STEP file in mode D.
legacy.재질과 좌표를 정하고 계산하세요: Set materials and coordinates, then calculate
Set the part materials, the Tool origin and the TCP, then calculate the mass properties.
Choose a robot to compare, then check the margins against its limits and the final result.
legacy.Tool의 STEP CAD 파일이 있으면 모드 D를 고릅니다. 질량·무게: If you have the Tool's STEP CAD file, choose mode D. Mass, center of gravity and inertia are calculated from the CAD.
legacy.불러오기를 눌러 Tool의 STEP 파일을 고르면 부품 목록과 3D 모델: Press Import and choose the Tool's STEP file; the part list and the 3D model appear.
legacy.부품별 재질 지정: Set a material for each part
legacy.부품마다 재질을 고르면 밀도가 바뀌어 질량에 반영됩니다. 예시는 공압 피: Choosing a material for a part changes its density and therefore the mass. The example sets the air fitting to brass.
legacy.Tool 원점과 TCP 설정: Set the Tool origin and TCP
legacy.Tool 원점은 플랜지에 닿는 면, TCP는 흡착 패드 끝처럼 작업하는: The Tool origin is the face that meets the flange; the TCP is the working point, such as the suction pad tip. Enter the values or use Pick point on the CAD.
legacy.질량 특성 계산을 누르면 Tool 원점 기준 질량·무게중심·관성모멘트가: Press Calculate mass properties to get the mass, center of gravity and moments of inertia about the Tool origin.
Choose the robot to compare the results with. The example uses SCARA S4.
Press Evaluate Robot Suitability to see the calculated value, the limit and the margin for each item.
